newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank postpones key board meeting.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank postpones key board meeting.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said in a statement on Tuesday that it had postponed a board meeting scheduled for Thursday.
The central bank said that it was postponing the meeting as many of the board members are expected to be either travelling or attending other business on Thursday.
It did not say when the meeting would be held.
The central bank had said it planned to review at the board meeting a proposal to set a direction to lower banks' reserve requirements and at the same time raise the liquidity ratio.
"The central bank will continue to take action to adjust the financial condition based on economic and financial situation at home and abroad," the statement said.
